observations: Photo 0, 1, 2 show a complete V8 engine block with intake manifold, wiring, and pulleys, photographed outdoors on paving stones.
The engine has a black plastic intake cover with embossed lettering readable as 'PORSCHE' in photo 0 and photo 1.
No VIN plate, engine code sticker, or displacement marking is legible in any photo.
A semi-transparent watermark reading 'EZE PORSCHE GLOBAL AUTOS' appears across all three photos; this is the seller's own branding, not a marking on the engine itself.
No wiring harness connectors, ECU, or ancillary sensors are shown attached beyond what is visible on the block, so completeness cannot be confirmed.
No start-up, compression test, or oil/coolant condition is shown in any photo.

claims.claim: We also deal on all kinds of car spare parts
claims.evidence: General business claim, not shown or contradicted by the photos.

risks.risk: Engine may not run or may have internal damage (compression, bearings, timing chain).
risks.proof: A video clip of the engine being started and idling, plus a compression test reading.
risks.if_unproven: priced as not working / for parts only

risks.risk: Engine may be missing ancillary components (ECU, wiring harness, turbo/supercharger unit, sensors) needed for installation.
risks.proof: Full-angle photos showing all harness connectors, intake/exhaust manifolds, and any turbo/supercharger attached.
risks.if_unproven: priced as incomplete, requiring additional parts

risks.risk: Exact model/displacement (e.g., 4.5L, 4.8L, S or Turbo variant) cannot be confirmed, which affects compatibility and value.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the engine code/VIN sticker or a casting number stamped on the block.
risks.if_unproven: priced at the lowest-value Porsche V8 variant until engine code is confirmed

risks.risk: Mileage and maintenance history are unknown; engine could be from an accident or high-mileage vehicle.
risks.proof: Seller-provided documentation such as a donor vehicle logbook or part-out photos showing mileage cluster.

risks.risk: Visible corrosion/oxidation on some surfaces could indicate prolonged outdoor storage, affecting seals and gaskets.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of gasket surfaces and oil pan for rust or leakage staining.

proof_requests: Clear photo of the engine code/casting number or VIN-linked identification plate.
Video of the engine running or being turned over, with audible sound.
Wide shots showing all sides of the engine including underside, to confirm completeness of ancillaries.
Any paperwork or donor vehicle photos indicating mileage or origin.
response.reason: The item is identifiable as a used Porsche V8 engine from embossed casting text, but with no engine code, running proof, or completeness shown, it must be priced at worst case as an untested, possibly incomplete unit.
